project.ndaTitle: The full passport opens after an NDA
project.ndaText: The full project passport, financial model and data room open only after the investor is vetted and signs an NDA. This public page shows a short description only.

account.registerLead: Open a cabinet as an investor, project owner or member. One account can have several roles.
account.passwordHint: At least 12 characters, with letters and digits
account.name: Full name
account.totpNeeded: Verification required: enter the code from your authenticator app.
account.locked: The account is temporarily locked. Try again in 10 minutes.
account.exists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
account.registered: Registration complete. You can now sign in.

dashboard.title: My account
dashboard.noSubmissions: No submissions yet. After you send a form its status will appear here.
dashboard.deleteConfirm: Send an account deletion request? A staff member will review it.

twofa.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
twofa.intro: An authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis and others) gives a code that changes every 30 seconds.
twofa.secretLabel: Secret key (enter it manually in the app)
twofa.disableHelp: Enter your current code to turn it off.
twofa.requiredDataroom: 2FA is required to open a data room.
twofa.requiredAdmin: 2FA is required for the admin panel. Turn it on and verify your code.
twofa.invalid: The code is incorrect or expired

dataroom.anonymousText: Sign in with an investor account to open the data room.
dataroom.notInvestorText: The data room is open to vetted investors. Please submit an investor application first.
dataroom.notEligible: Access is open to investors who passed vetting. See your assessment result in the cabinet.
dataroom.twoFactorSetup: Two-factor authentication (2FA) is required for the data room. Turn on 2FA first.
dataroom.twoFactorVerify: Verify your 2FA code in this session to unlock access.
dataroom.signText: Once you accept the NDA the data room opens for 90 days. Every view is logged and documents carry a personal watermark (name and date).
dataroom.accept: I have read the NDA terms and agree
dataroom.invalidCode: The 2FA code is incorrect or expired
dataroom.noFiles: No documents have been uploaded for this project yet.
dataroom.viewOnly: Documents are view-only; your name and the date appear on every page.
dataroom.denied: No access. The NDA, investor level and 2FA are checked.
